text:
sarah: Heads up — canary promo blocked. Staging Buildkite job #4578 failed during artifact extract on runner 'buildkite-8-3' with OOM + symlink errors. Holding promo for now.

deploy-bot: deploybot: Promo held for canary due to failed smoke job 4578 (reason: artifact extract failure).

leo: Can you paste the exact error lines?

sarah: ```
tar: ./app/node_modules/.bin/parcel: Cannot create symlink: Operation not permitted
ERROR: exit status 2
[2026-03-21T12:31:40Z] buildkite-agent: oom-kill invoked: process pid=1723 rss=1.9G
Out of memory while decompressing layer 3
```

priya: Symlink errors + OOM is odd. Did we change the base image or the buildkite-agent version on that pool?

jamie: We rolled agent -> v3.4.1 to that pool yesterday (buildkite-8). I saw a small memory spike around the same time.

anita: @ops-bot can you confirm mount options and any kernel/selinux differences on buildkite-8?

ops-bot: ops-bot: Mount options for buildkite-8 pool: overlayfs (userxattr), noexec not set. No recent mount config changes in last 48h. Kernel OOM event logged at 6843219900 on buildkite-8-3.

leo: If it's OOM, a retry on a different runner might pass. But the tar symlink failure indicates the extractor runs as an unprivileged user and the filesystem disallows creating symlinks in the workspace. That could be due to how the volume is mounted into the container.

priya: Could also be an interaction with the agent upgrade that changed how artifacts are streamed/extracted.

jamie: Plan: requeue a rerun pinned to BUILD_POOL=legacy-hosts and downgrade agent to 3.4.0 for that job run. That should isolate whether the agent change caused it.

sarah: For release decision: recommend pinning canary to last good promotion (build 6843100000 / image sha256:deadbeef) and rerun failing job on legacy pool. Any objections?

priya: :thumbsup: from me. Also let's add a short note to release notes under Known Issues so support/oncall are aware.

jamie: I'll re-run now with BUILD_POOL=legacy-hosts and force agent=3.4.0 env.

deploy-bot: deploybot: Manual pin applied: promoted image ref 'sha256:deadbeef' pinned for canary. Promo remains held.

anita: Opening ticket and adding infra team to investigate mount/agent change. Will include logs + runner metadata.

leo: If rerun passes, propose manual promote after 2 successful smoke runs on legacy pool, and cc SRE on the promote decision.

priya: Draft release note text suggestion: "Temporary canary pin due to CI artifact extraction failures on a new agent; reruns in progress and infra investigating."

sarah: Good. I'll add that to the release notes and ping #product for visibility.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Created ticket INFRA-9234: "runner symlink + oom during artifact extract on buildkite-8" assigned to @anita. Link: https://tracker.redwood.ai/INFRA-9234

anita: Assigned INFRA-9234 to infra-team, setting priority=P0 for release unblock. Collecting kernel dmesg and agent logs now.

jamie: Rerun queued on legacy-hosts. I'll report back in ~10m.

sarah: Thanks everyone. Once we have 2 green smoke reruns we can decide manual promote. I'll keep promo held until signoff.

deploy-bot: deploybot: Waiting on manual unblock. Use `/deploybot promote --pin-reason "ci-extract-failure"` once infra confirms.

sarah: :white_check_mark: closing loop — will update when rerun statuses are in.
